Simplified: The Tenant and household members will not smoke anywhere in the Property and will not allow guests to smoke in the Property.

Original: Upon any notice required under the Act, or no notice where there is no Act or the Act does not specify, the Landlord may terminate this tenancy where the Tenant has breached any provision of this rental, including the failure to pay the Rent for at least one month.
Simplified: Upon any required notice, or no notice where there is no law or the law does not say otherwise, the Landlord may end this tenancy if the Tenant fails to pay the Rent for at least one month.

Original: The Landlord covenants that on paying the Rent and performing the covenants contained in this Lease, the Tenant will peacefully and quietly have, hold, and enjoy the Property for the agreed term.
Simplified: The Landlord promises that upon paying the rent and fulfilling the terms of this lease, the Tenant will have the right to peacefully use and enjoy the Property for the agreed period.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: applying adhesive materials, or inserting nails or hooks in walls or ceilings other than two small picture hooks per wall.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before applying adhesive materials or inserting nails or hooks into walls or ceilings, except for two small picture hooks per wall.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: painting, wallpapering, redecorating or in any way significantly altering the appearance of the Property.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before painting, wallpapering, redecorating, or significantly changing the appearance of the Property.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: removing or adding walls, or performing any structural alterations.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before removing or adding walls or making any structural changes.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: changing the amount of heat or power normally used on the Property as well as installing additional electrical wiring or heating units.
Simplified:
The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before:
- Changing the usual amount of heat or power used on the Property
- Installing additional electrical wiring or heating units

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: placing or exposing or allowing to be placed or exposed anywhere inside or outside the Property any placard, notice or sign for advertising or any other purpose.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before placing or exposing any placard, notice, or sign for advertising or any other purpose inside or outside the Property.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: affixing to or erecting upon or near the Property any radio or TV antenna or tower.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before attaching or placing any radio or TV antenna or tower on or near the Property.

Original: In the event that any action is filed in relation to this Lease, the unsuccessful Party in the action will pay to the successful Party, in addition to all the sums that either Party may be called on to pay, a reasonable sum for the successful Party's attorney fees.
Simplified: If any legal action is taken regarding this Lease, the losing party will pay the winning party a reasonable amount for attorney fees, in addition to any other sums that may be due.

Original: This Lease will be construed in accordance with, and exclusively governed by, the laws of Uttar Pradesh.
Simplified: This Lease will be interpreted and governed by the laws of Uttar Pradesh.

Original: If there is a conflict between any provision of this Lease and the applicable legislation of Uttar Pradesh (the "Act"), the Act will prevail and such provisions of the Lease will be amended or deleted as necessary in order to comply with the Act. Further, any provisions that are required by the Act are incorporated into this Lease.
Simplified: If there is a conflict between this Lease and Uttar Pradesh's legislation (the "Act"), the Act will prevail. Any Lease provisions that conflict must be amended or removed to comply with the Act. The Act's required provisions are also included in this Lease.

Original: The invalidity or unenforceability of any provisions of this Lease will not affect the validity or enforceability of any other provision of this Lease. Such other provisions remain in full force and effect.
Simplified: The invalidity or unenforceability of any part of this Lease does not affect other parts. Those other parts remain valid and enforceable.

Original: This Lease may only be amended or modified by a written document executed by the Parties.
Simplified: This Lease can only be changed by a written agreement from both Parties.

Original: Without the prior, express, and written consent of the Landlord, the Tenant will not assign this Lease, or sublet or grant any concession or licence to use the Property or any part of the Property.
Simplified: Without the Landlord's prior, written consent, the Tenant may not assign this Lease, sublet, or grant any use of the Property or part of it.

Original: A consent by the Landlord to one assignment, subletting, concession, or licence will not be deemed to be a consent to any subsequent assignment, subletting, concession, or licence.
Simplified: A consent by the Landlord to one assignment, subletting, concession, or license will not be deemed to be a consent to any subsequent assignment, subletting, concession, or license.

Original: Any assignment, subletting, concession, or licence without the prior written consent of the Landlord, or an assignment or subletting by operation of law, will be void and will, at the Landlord's option, terminate this Lease.
Simplified: Any assignment, subletting, or licence without the Landlord's prior written consent, or an assignment or subletting by law, will be void and may end this Lease.

Original: The Tenant will, at its sole expense, keep and maintain the Property and appurtenances in good and sanitary condition and repair during the term of this Lease and any renewal of this Lease.
Simplified: The Tenant will, at its own cost, keep and maintain the Property and related items in good and sanitary condition and repair during the lease term and any renewal.

Original: Major maintenance and repair of the Property not due to the Tenant's misuse, waste, or neglect or that of the Tenant's employee, family, agent, or visitor, will be the responsibility of the Landlord or the Landlord's assigns.
Simplified: Major maintenance and repair of the Property, not due to the Tenant's misuse, waste, or neglect or that of the Tenant's employees, family, agents, or visitors, will be the responsibility of the Landlord or the Landlord's assigns.

Original: The Tenant will promptly notify the Landlord of any damage, or of any situation that may significantly interfere with the normal use of the Property or to any furnishings supplied by the Landlord.
Simplified: The Tenant must quickly inform the Landlord of any damage or any situation that may seriously affect the normal use of the Property or any furnishings provided by the Landlord.

Original: The Tenant will not engage in any illegal trade or activity on or about the Property.
Simplified: The Tenant will not engage in any illegal activities on or around the Property.

Original: The Parties will comply with standards of health, sanitation, fire, housing and safety as required by law.
Simplified: The Parties must follow health, sanitation, fire, housing, and safety standards required by law.

Original: If the Tenant is absent from the Property and the Property is unoccupied for a period of 4 consecutive days or longer, the Tenant will arrange for regular inspection by a competent person.
Simplified: If the Tenant is absent and the Property is unoccupied for 4 days or more, the Tenant will arrange for regular inspections by a competent person.

Original: At the expiration of the term of this Lease, the Tenant will quit and surrender the Property in as good a state and condition as they were at the commencement of this Lease, reasonable use and wear and tear excepted.
Simplified: At the end of this lease, the tenant will return the property in good condition, as it was when the lease began, excluding normal wear and tear.

Original: During the term of this Lease or after its termination, the Landlord may charge the Tenant for replacement of locks and/or lost keys to the Property, and any administrative fees associated with the replacement as a result of the Tenant's misplacement of the keys.
Simplified: During the lease term or after, the Landlord may charge the Tenant for replacing locks and lost keys to the Property, as well as any related administrative fees if the keys are misplaced.

Original: The Tenant will obey all rules and regulations of the Landlord regarding the Property.
Simplified: The Tenant will follow all of the Landlord's rules for the Property.

Original: Any waiver by the Landlord of any failure by the Tenant to perform or observe the provisions of this Lease will not operate as a waiver of the Landlord's rights under this Lease in respect of any subsequent defaults, breaches or non-performance and will not defeat or affect in any way the Landlord's rights in respect of any subsequent default or breach.
Simplified: Any waiver by the Landlord of the Tenant's failure to follow this Lease will not affect the Landlord's rights for future defaults or breaches.

Original: This Lease will extend to and be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors and assigns, as the case may be, of each Party. All covenants are to be construed as conditions of this Lease.
Simplified: This Lease will apply to and benefit the heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns of each Party. All promises are conditions of this Lease.

Original: All sums payable by the Tenant to the Landlord pursuant to any provision of this Lease will be deemed to be additional rent and will be recovered by the Landlord as rental arrears.
Simplified: All payments by the Tenant to the Landlord under this Lease will be considered additional rent and collected as rental arrears.

Original: Locks may not be added or changed without the prior written agreement of both Parties.
Simplified: No Party may add or change locks without both Parties' prior written agreement.

Original: This Lease may be executed in counterparts. Facsimile signatures are binding and are considered to be original signatures.
Simplified: This lease can be signed in parts. Fax signatures are valid and count as original signatures.

Original: This Lease constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties. Any prior understanding or representation of any kind preceding the date of this Lease will not be binding on either Party except to the extent incorporated in this Lease.
Simplified: This lease is the full agreement between the parties. Any previous understanding or representation is not binding, except as included in this lease.

Original: It is the intent of this Lease and agreed to by the Parties to this Lease that rent for this Lease will be on a gross rent basis meaning the Tenant will pay the Base Rent and any Additional Rent and the Landlord will be responsible for all other service charges related to the Premises and the operation of the Building save as specifically provided in this Lease to the contrary.
Simplified: It is agreed that the Tenant will pay the Base Rent and any Additional Rent, and the Landlord will cover all other service charges related to the Premises and the Building, except as specifically stated otherwise in this Lease.

Original: The Premises will be used for only the following permitted use (the "Permitted Use").
Simplified: The Premises will be used only for the Permitted Use.

Original: The term of the Lease commences at 12:00 noon on 8 October 2026 and ends at 12:00 noon on 8 October 2026 (the "Term").
Simplified: The lease term starts at noon on October 8, 2026, and ends at noon on October 8, 2026 (the "Term").

Original: Should the Tenant remain in possession of the Premises with the consent of the Landlord after the natural expiration of this Lease, a new tenancy from month to month will be created between the Landlord and the Tenant which will be subject to all the terms and conditions of this Lease but will be terminable upon either party giving one month's notice to the other party.
Simplified: If the Tenant stays in the Premises with the Landlord's permission after the lease ends, a month-to-month tenancy will be created. This tenancy will follow all the terms of the original lease and can be ended by either party giving one month's notice.

Original: The Tenant will pay the cost of any applicable stamp duty.
Simplified: The Tenant will pay any applicable stamp duty.

Original: No acceptance by the Landlord of any amount less than the full amount owed will be taken to operate as a waiver by the Landlord for the full amount or in any way to defeat or affect the rights and remedies of the Landlord to pursue the full amount.
Simplified: No partial payment will be considered a waiver of the full amount owed. The Landlord can still pursue the full amount.

Original: Subject to the provisions of this Lease, the Tenant will pay a base rent of ₹10000, payable per month, for the Premises (the "Base Rent"), without setoff, abatement or deduction.
Simplified: Subject to this Lease, the Tenant will pay ₹10,000 per month as Base Rent for the Premises, without setoff, abatement, or deduction.

Original: The Tenant will carry on and conduct its business from time to time carried on upon the Premises in such manner as to comply with all statutes, bylaws, rules and regulations of any union, state, local or other competent authority and will not do anything on or in the Premises in contravention of any of them.
Simplified: The Tenant will conduct its business on the Premises in compliance with all applicable statutes, bylaws, rules, and regulations. The Tenant will not do anything on or in the Premises that violates these rules.

Original: The Landlord covenants that on paying the Rent and performing the covenants contained in this Lease, the Tenant will peacefully and quietly have, hold, and enjoy the Premises for the agreed term.
Simplified: The Landlord promises that upon paying the rent and fulfilling the terms of this lease, the Tenant will have the right to peacefully use and occupy the Premises for the agreed period.

Original: If and whenever the Tenant is in default in payment of any money, whether hereby expressly reserved or deemed as rent, or any part of the rent, the Landlord may, without notice or any form of legal process, enter upon the Premises and seize, remove and sell the Tenant's goods, chattels and equipment from the Premises.
Simplified: If the Tenant fails to pay any money, including rent or part of the rent, the Landlord may enter the Premises and seize, remove, and sell the Tenant's goods without notice or legal process.

Original: If the Landlord reenters the Premises or terminates this Lease, then the provisions of this Lease relating to the consequences of termination will survive.
Simplified: If the Landlord reenters the Premises or terminates this Lease, the termination provisions will survive.

Original: The Landlord may rel et the Premises or any part of the Premises for a term or terms which may be less or greater than the balance of the Term remaining and may grant reasonable concessions in connection with such reletting including any alterations and improvements to the Premises.
Simplified: The Landlord may sublet the Premises or part of the Premises for a term less or greater than the remaining Term and may offer reasonable concessions, including alterations and improvements to the Premises.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before doing any of the following: painting, wallpapering, redecorating or in any way significantly altering the appearance of the Premises.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before painting, wallpapering, redecorating, or significantly changing the appearance of the Premises.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before removing or adding walls or performing any structural alterations.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before removing or adding walls or making any structural changes.

Original: The Tenant will obtain written permission from the Landlord before changing the amount of heat or power normally used on the Premises as well as installing additional electrical wiring or heating units.
Simplified: The Tenant must get written permission from the Landlord before changing heat or power usage, installing additional electrical wiring, or heating units.

Original: The rental term begins on [Date] (“Start Date”) and continues as follows:— OPTION 1 Month-to-month. The rental tenancy of the Property will continue on a month-to-month basis until terminated under the terms of this agreement.
Simplified: The rental term starts on [Date] ("Start Date") and continues month-to-month until terminated as per this agreement.

Original: OPTION 2 Lease. The lease of the Property will continue for one calendar year or until [Date]. Any holdover of the Property thereafter will be on a month-to-month basis.
Simplified: OPTION 2 LEASE. The lease of the Property will continue for one year or until [Date]. Any further occupancy will be on a month-to-month basis.

Original: Tenants agree to pay [Rent] to rent the Property, and such payments will be made (after the initial payment due on the date of signing) on or before the first day of each month.
Simplified: Tenants agree to pay [Rent] each month, with the first payment due on the signing date.

Original: If the Start Date is on a day other than the first of the month, rent will be prorated for the first month.
Simplified: If the start date is not on the first of the month, rent will be prorated for the first month.

Original: If payments are sent by mail, they must be sent sufficiently in advance of the due date to ensure delivery on or before the first day of the month.
Simplified: If payments are mailed, they must be sent early enough to ensure they are delivered by the first day of the month.

Original: Tenants will pay Landlord a security deposit of [Deposit] on the day this Residential Lease Agreement is signed.
Simplified: Tenants will pay the Landlord a security deposit of [Deposit] on the day this Residential Lease Agreement is signed.

Original: Landlord is not required to keep security deposit funds in a trust account, nor required to pay any interest on it, unless required by law.
Simplified: Landlord does not have to keep security deposit in a trust account or pay interest on it, unless required by law.

Original: Within 30 days of the termination of this lease (and Tenant vacating the Property), Landlord will provide the Tenants with an itemized statement showing any retention of any portions of the Security Deposit amount for the cost of repair or cleaning above and beyond the ordinary wear and tear on the Property or any other sums due to Landlord under this Residential Lease Agreement.
Simplified: Within 30 days after the lease ends and Tenant moves out, Landlord will give Tenants a list showing any part of the Security Deposit kept for repairs or cleaning beyond normal wear and tear or other amounts owed under this agreement.

Original: Tenants are not permitted to treat the Security Deposit as payment of any rent payment.
Simplified: Tenants may not use the Security Deposit to pay rent.

Original: Late fees of [Fee] per day will apply beginning on the fifth day of each month if payment is not timely made or the maximum amount authorized by law.
Simplified: Late fees of [Fee] per day will apply starting on the fifth day of each month if payment is not timely made or as allowed by law.

Original: उन नियमों का वर्णन करता है, जिनसे आप हमारी सेवाओं का उपयोग करते समय सहमत होते हैं.
Simplified: उपयोग करते समय सहमत होने वाले नियमों का वर्णन करता है.

Original: जब आप हमारी वेबसाइट या ऐप, हमारे उत्पादों या सेवाओं में प्रवेश करके, हमारे उपयोगकर्ता डेटाबेस में भाग लेकर या हमारी सहायता टीम के साथ बातचीत करना चुनते हैं, तो आप स्वीकार करते हैं कि आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को इस गोपनीयता नीति में वर्णित रूप से व्यवहार किया जाएगा।
Simplified: जब आप हमारी वेबसाइट या ऐप, उत्पाद या सेवा में प्रवेश करते हैं, या हमारे सहायता टीम से बातचीत करते हैं, तो आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को गोपनीयता नीति के अनुसार व्यवहार किया जाएगा।

Original: यह वेबसाइट 18 वर्ष से कम आयु के व्यक्तियों के लिए अभिप्रेत नहीं है।
Simplified: यह वेबसाइट 18 वर्ष से कम आयु के लोगों के लिए अनुमति नहीं है।

Original: हम जानबूझकर बच्चों से या उनके बारे में व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं मांगते या एकत्र करते हैं, और हम जानबूझकर बच्चों के लिए अपने उत्पादों या सेवाओं का विपणन नहीं करते हैं।
Simplified: हम बच्चों से या उनके बारे में व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं मांगते और बच्चों के लिए उत्पाद या सेवाओं का विपणन नहीं करते।

Original: हम आपकी उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी, आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी सहित को अनधिकृत या अनुचित पहुंच, उपयोग या प्रकटीकरण से सुरक्षित रखने के लिए सख्त भौतिक, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक और प्रशासनिक सुरक्षा उपाय बनाए रखते हैं।
Simplified: हम आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी से सुरक्षित रखने के लिए भौतिक, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक और प्रशासनिक सुरक्षा उपाय बनाए रखते हैं।

Original: हम यह सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि जब हम आपकी जानकारी को तृतीय पक्षों के साथ साझा करते हैं, तो हम अनुबंधित रूप से ऐसे तृतीय पक्षों से उचित सुरक्षा प्रथाओं का पालन करने और आपकी जानकारी की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए पर्याप्त सुरक्षा उपाय करने की अपेक्षा करते हैं।
Simplified: हम यह सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि जब हम आपकी जानकारी को तृतीय पक्षों के साथ साझा करते हैं, तो वे उचित सुरक्षा प्रथाओं का पालन करें और आपकी जानकारी की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करें।

Original: इन शर्तों को समझना इसलिए ज़रूरी है, क्योंकि हमारी सेवाओं को ऐक्सेस करने या इस्तेमाल करने का मतलब है कि आप इन शर्तों से सहमत हैं.
Simplified: इन शर्तों को समझें, क्योंकि आपको हमारी सेवाओं का उपयोग करने की अनुमति देने का मतलब है कि आप इन शर्तों से सहमत हैं.

Original: उपरोक्त के अलावा, हम उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी केवल तभी जारी करते हैं जब कानून के तहत इसकी अनुमति हो या कानूनी अनुपालन और कानून प्रवर्तन के लिए कानून द्वारा आवश्यक हो।
Simplified: उपरोक्त के अलावा, हम जेसे ही कानून के तहत अनुमति हो या कानूनी अनुपालन और कानून प्रवर्तन के लिए आवश्यक हो, उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी जारी करते हैं।

Original: आप हमसे संपर्क करके किसी भी समय अपनी उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी प्राप्त करने का अनुरोध कर सकते हैं जो हमारे पास है।
Simplified: आप हमसे संपर्क करके किसी भी समय अपनी उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी प्राप्त कर सकते हैं जो हमारे पास है।

Original: आपको अपनी पहचान सत्यापित करनी होगी।
Simplified: आपको पहचान सत्यापित करनी होगी।

Original: हमारे द्वारा कुछ जानकारी प्रदान करना संभव नहीं हो सकता यदि ऐसी जानकारी प्रदान करने से दूसरों की गोपनीयता में हस्तक्षेप होता है।
Simplified: हमारे पास ऐसी जानकारी प्रदान करने से दूसरों की गोपनीयता का हस्तक्षेप होता है, इसलिए इसका प्रदान करना संभव नहीं हो सकता।

Original: हम उपयोगकर्ता की जानकारी को तब तक बनाए रखते हैं जब तक कि यह इस गोपनीयता नीति में बताए गए उद्देश्यों के लिए आवश्यक है।
Simplified: हम उपयोगकर्ता की जानकारी को बनाए रखते हैं जब तक कि यह गोपनीयता नीति के उद्देश्यों के लिए आवश्यक है।

Original: हम उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी को, जैसा हम उचित समझें, हटाने, निपटाने, अज्ञात करने या अलग करने के लिए सभी उचित उपाय करते हैं, जब हमारे पास ऐसी उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी को संसाधित करने की वैध आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।
Simplified: हम उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी को हटाते, निपटाते, अज्ञात करते या अलग करते हैं जब इसकी संसाधित करनी वैध नहीं होती।

Original: यह गोपनीयता नीति भारत के कानूनों के अनुसार नियंत्रित और संचालित होती है।
Simplified: यह गोपनीयता नीति भारत के कानूनों के अनुसार चलती है।
